About Saiyar Ethnic Studio

A women's ethnic-wear rental studio in Nikol, Ahmedabad.

  1. Home
  2. About Us

Beautiful outfits, rented smartly

Saiyar Ethnic Studio exists for customers who want to look their best at weddings, receptions, engagements, festivals and Garba nights, without paying the full cost of an outfit they may wear only once.

Our focus is renting. You can explore wedding cholis, heavy and designer sarees and wedding gowns, with outfits ranging from ₹500 to ₹10,000 depending on the look.

What you can find

  • Wedding cholis for bridal celebrations, receptions and Garba.
  • Heavy and designer sarees for wedding guests and festive evenings.
  • Wedding gowns for receptions and engagements.

Find us in Nikol

We are on Nikol Gam Road, Ahmedabad. Message us on WhatsApp first so we can confirm availability, then visit the studio.
